description: Compile and run a Goose program with the locally installed toolchain. Writes the code to a temporary directory, runs `goose main.goose` there, and returns the exit code, stdout and stderr. Requires Goose to be installed on the machine (see toolchain_status). Times out after 10s by default.

args.description: Arguments passed to the program after `--`.

code.description: Complete Goose source code to compile and run.

timeoutMs.description: Kill the process after this many milliseconds. Default 10000, max 60000.

name: run_code
